content: Yen biru Ahitofɛli u Abusɑlɔmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ de n tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (12.000) ɡɔsi kpɑ n Dɑfidi nɑɑ swĩi wɔ̃ku te.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u ko n wɑsire, u ǹ ko n mɑɑ dɑm ɡɑm mɔ, kpɑ n nùn nɑre. Win tɔmbu bɑ̀ n yɑrinɑ bɑ nùn deri wi turo, kpɑ n nùn sɛ̃re n ɡo.
Mɛsumɑ kon ko Isirelibɑ kpuro bu kɑ wurɑmɑ wunɛn mi. Domi wi ɑ kɑsu mi, sɑ̀ n nùn nɔmɑ turɑ, be kpuro bɑ koo wurɑmɑ wunɛn mi, kpɑ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Mɑ ɡɑri yi, yi Abusɑlɔmu kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kpuro dore.
Adɑmɑ Abusɑlɔmu u nɛɛ, bu Usɑi Aɑkiɡii sokumɑ kpɑ bu mɑɑ nɔ ye win tii koo ɡere.
Ye Usɑi u tunumɑ Abusɑlɔmun mi, mɑ Abusɑlɔmu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Ahitofɛli u ɡeruɑ. Yɑ nun wɛ̃re su ko mɛ? Nɡe ɑmɔnɑ ɑ wɑ.
Usɑi u nɛɛ, Ahitofɛlin bwisi yi u nun kɛ̃mɔ mini ɡisɔ, yi ǹ bwisi ɡee.

Wunɛn tii, ɑ wunɛn tundo kɑ win tɔmbu yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔbu. Bɑ kɔ̃ruɑwɑ nɡe ɡbeeku yɑɑ ɡɔbɑ ye bɑ binu mwɑɑri. Yen biru ɑ yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛn tundo wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbun sɑriɑ yɛ̃ro. U ǹ wurɑmɔ u kpunɑ kɑ tɔn be sɑnnu.
Wee ɑ̀ n dɑ tɛ̃, u kukuɑ kpee wɔru ɡɑɡu sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ yɑm ɡɑm. Win tɔmbu bɑ̀ n ɡbiɑ bɑ sun wɔri, mɑ bɑ bɛsɛn ɡɑbu ɡo, wi u ye nuɑ, u koo nɛɛ, wee, bɑ Abusɑlɔmun tɔmbu ɡo ɡo.

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ, bɑɑ ɡoo ù n sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu durɔ, mɑ u wɔruɡɔru mɔ nɡe ɡbee sunɔ, yɛ̃ro koo bɛrum duurɑ. Domi Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛn tundo u sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu durɔ. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ tɑbu kowo dɑmɡibu mɔ.
Bwisi yi nɑ mɔ kon nun kɛ̃ wee. A de Isirelibɑ kpuro be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Dɑnun di sere kɑ Beri Sebɑɔ bu mɛnnɑ bɑ n dɑbi nɡe yɑni sɛɛri nim wɔ̃kun ɡoorɔ kpɑ wunɛn tii ɑ n bu ɡbiiye i kɑ tɑɑ bi dɑ.
Kpɑ su bu wɔri subɑru sɔɔ mi bɑ ɡesi wɑ̃ɑ su bu wukiri mɑm mɑm nɡe mɛ dirum mu rɑ yɑkɑsu wukiri. Sɑ̀ n kuɑ mɛ, ben ɡoo kun kisirɑmɔ bɑɑ sunɔn tii.
Bɑ̀ n duɑ wuu ɡɑɡu sɔɔ bɑ kukuɑ, Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ koo wuu ɡe wɔri bu ɡen ɡɑni wɛ̃ɛ sɔ̃re bu ɡɑwɑ bu suriri kpɑ bu ɡen kpenu ɡurɑ bu dɑ bu sure wɔwɑ sɔɔ. Bɑɑ ɡen kpee teerɑ kun tiɑrɑmɔ.
Mɑ Abusɑlɔmu kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ nɛɛ, Usɑi Aɑkiɡiin bwisi yi, yi Ahitofɛliɡii kere. N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u kĩ u Ahitofɛlin bwisi ɡee yi sĩiyɑ kpɑ kɔ̃sɑ yu Abusɑlɔmu deemɑ.
Bɑ Dɑfidi bwisi kɑ̃ u kɑ dukɑ
Yerɑ Usɑi u dɑ u Sɑdɔku kɑ Abiɑtɑɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mɛni kɑ mɛniwɑ Ahitofɛli u Abusɑlɔmu kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu bwisi kɑ̃. Mɑ nɛ, nɑ mɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛni kɑ mɛni.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ ɡoo ɡɔrio tɛ̃ Dɑfidin mi, u nùn sɔ̃ u ku rɑɑ kpunɑ dɑɑ ten tɔburɑ yerɔ ɡbɑburu mi, wɔ̃ku te. U tɔburo u doonɑ kɑ win tɔmbu kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ bu nɔmɑ turi bu ɡo.

N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Yonɑtɑm kɑ Akimɑsi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Eni Roɡɛliɔ domi bɑ ǹ kɑ̃kɔ bu du wuuɔ ɡoo u bu wɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ rɑ wɔndiɑ ɡoo ɡɔri ben mi, u bu sɔ̃ kpuro ye yɑ koorɑmɔ, kpɑ be mɑɑ bu dɑ bu Dɑfidi sinɑ boko sɔ̃.

Adɑmɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru, ɑluwɑɑsi ɡoo u bu wɑ mɑ u dɑ u Abusɑlɔmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ seewɑ fuuku fuuku, bɑ yɑkurɑ bɑ dɑ durɔ ɡoon yɛnuɔ Bɑhurimuɔ. N deemɑ durɔ wi, u dɔkɔ mɔ win yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ duɑ ye sɔɔ bɑ kukuɑ.
Yerɑ durɔ win kurɔ u bekuru ɡɑru suɑ u kɑ dɔkɔ ye wukiri mɑ u dobi yi bɑ surɑ tɛriɑ ten wɔllɔ kpɑ bu ku kɑ ɡiɑ mɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.

Ye Abusɑlɔmun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ yɛnu mi, yerɑ bɑ kurɔ wi bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ Akimɑsi kɑ Yonɑtɑm bɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ dɑɑ piibu ɡeni tɔburɑ bɑ doonɑ. Bɑ bu kɑsu kɑsu bɑ ǹ wɑ. Mɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.

Ye bɑ doonɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ Yonɑtɑm kɑ Akimɑsi bɑ yɑrimɑ dɔkɔ yen min di, bɑ dɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u seewo fuuku kɑ win tɔmbu bu dɑɑ te tɔburɑ bu doonɑ. Domi ɑmɛniwɑ Ahitofɛli u Abusɑlɔmu bwisi kɑ̃ win sɔ̃.
Ye Dɑfidi u ɡɑri yi nuɑ, mɑ u seewɑ kɑ win tɔmbu u Yuudɛnin dɑɑ te tɔburɑ. Be kpurowɑ bɑ doonɑ yɑm mu sere sɑ̃rɑ.

Ye Ahitofɛli u wɑ bɑ ǹ kɑ win ɡɑri sɔmburu kue, yerɑ u win kɛtɛku ɡɑɑri bɔkuɑ u sĩɑ win wuuɔ, u dɑ win tiin yɛnuɔ u win yɛnuɡibu sɑɑriɑ kpuro mɛ bɑ koo koosinɑ. Yen biru u win tii soorɑ doke u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑn sikirɔ.
Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ Mɑhɑnɑimuɔ
Ye Dɑfidi u turɑ Mɑhɑnɑimuɔ, sɑɑ yerɑ, Abusɑlɔmu u Yuudɛnin dɑɑru tɔburɑmɑ, wi kɑ win tɔmbu kpuro.
U Amɑsɑ kuɑ win tɑbu sunɔ Yoɑbun ɑyerɔ. Amɑsɑn tundon yĩsirɑ Yitirɑ, Isireli
. Win mɛrowɑ Abiɡɑli, Nɑkɑsin bii. Wi kɑ Seruyɑ, Yoɑbun mɛro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ mɔɔ kɑ wɔnɔ.
Abusɑlɔmu kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑwɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ.
Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ Mɑhɑnɑimuɔ, yerɑ Sobi, Nɑkɑsin bii, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Amɔnibɑn bweseru sɑɑ Rɑbɑn di, kɑ Mɑkiri Amiɛlin bii sɑɑ Lodebɑɑn di, kɑ Bɑɑsilɑi, Gɑlɑdiɡii, sɑɑ Roɡɛlimun di,
bɑ kɑ Dɑfidi kpin yenu nɑɑwɑ kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ bɑsilɑbɑ, kɑ wekenu, kɑ mɑɑ dĩɑnu. Niyɑ ɑlikɑmɑ kɑ ɔɔsu, kɑ som, kɑ ɡbere wɔ̃ɔrɑnu kɑ swii kɑ dɑ̃si kɑ sɔ̃ki yi bɑ sɔnwɑ,
kɑ tim, kɑ nɑɑ boɡum kɑ yɑ̃ɑ yɑɑ, kɑ ɡɑsɑnu. Domi bɑ nɛɛ, ɡɔ̃ɔru kɑ nim nɔru kɑ wɑsirɑru, yɑ ko n tɔn be wɑhɑlɑ koomɛ ɡbɑburun di.
Bɑ Abusɑlɔmun tɑbu kowobu
kɑmiɑ

footnotes.text: Isireli - Bɑndun Gɑri I, 2:17 sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, Yitirɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isimɛɛli.
